sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Front Office hotel ka sabse important module hai — yahi guest ka pehle contact (check-in) se last contact (check-out & billing) tak ka pura journey manage karta hai.

Analysis HMS me Front Office Module guest registration, room assignment, folio (bill) management, in-house guest tracking, check-out settlement aur saare related reports handle karta hai. Ye training manual front desk staff ko step-by-step system operate karna sikhata hai.

GUEST JOURNEY (Training Flow):
Reservation/Enquiry → Guest Arrival → Registration (GRC) → Room Assign → Check-In → Stay (charges post, room change, folio merge) → Check-Out → Bill Settlement → Bill Print → Guest History

Live room status — kaunsa room available/dirty/occupied

Multiple payment modes with GST auto-calculation

sections.title: 3. Master Module — Setup & Configuration
sections.intro: Master setup ek baar hota hai — property ke rooms, rates, sources aur parameters define karte hain. Front desk ko ye sirf samajhne ke liye chahiye, entries mainly admin karta hai.

subsections.title: 3.1 FOM Parameter
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Fom Parameter
subsections.paragraph: Front Office Module ke global settings — check-in/check-out time, tax rules, folio printing rules, GRC format parameters etc. Ye poore module ka behaviour control karte hain.

subsections.title: 3.2 Business Source
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Business Source
subsections.paragraph: Business kahan se aa raha hai — Walk-In, Phone, WhatsApp, OTA (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com), Corporate etc. Har check-in pe business source select hota hai, jisse baad me Revenue Source Report banta hai.

subsections.title: 3.3 Guest Status
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Guest Status
subsections.paragraph: Guest categories define karo — Regular, VIP, Corporate Guest, Complimentary etc. VIP guest ka special handling aur alerts isi se hote hain.

subsections.title: 3.4 Charge Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Charge Master
subsections.paragraph: Room ke alawa jo charges post ho sakte hain unki list — Laundry, Restaurant, Mini Bar, Extra Bed, Late Checkout. Ye charges guest folio me post hote hain.

subsections.title: 3.5 Plan Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Plan Master
subsections.paragraph: Room plans — EP (sirf room), CP (room + breakfast), MAP (breakfast + dinner), AP (all meals). Plan ka rate structure aur included meals yahin define hote hain.

subsections.title: 3.6 Room Features
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Room Features
subsections.paragraph: Room ki special features — Sea View, Balcony, Jacuzzi, Connecting Door. Room master me inhe attach karte hain.

subsections.title: 3.7 Room Category
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Room Category
subsections.paragraph: Room types define karo — Deluxe, Super Deluxe, Suite, Executive. Har category ka rate, occupancy (multiper) aur revenue code yahan set hota hai. Ye saare rates aur occupancy reports ki base hai.

subsections.title: 3.8 Room Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Room Master
subsections.paragraph: Har physical room ki entry — room number, category, floor, building, features aur QR code. Room QR generator bhi yahin se banta hai (housekeeper QR login ke liye).

subsections.title: 3.9 Booking Source
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Booking Source
subsections.paragraph: Reservation kahan se book hui — Direct, Agent, Corporate, OTA. Business Source se alag: ye booking channel track karta hai.

subsections.title: 3.10 Building Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Building Master
subsections.paragraph: Multi-building property me buildings define karo — Main Block, Annex, Service Wing. Rooms in buildings me distribute hote hain.

sections.title: 4. Operations Module — Guest Lifecycle
sections.intro: Ye front desk ka daily kaam hai — guest aaye to check-in, stay me manage, room status dekho. Training ka core section: har screen pehletry karo demo data ke saath.

subsections.title: 4.1 Blank GRC (Guest Registration Card)
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Blank GRC
subsections.paragraph: Khali registration card print karne ke liye — jab system down ho ya walk-in guest ka turant paper record chahiye. Baad me ye data system me daalna hota hai.

subsections.title: 4.2 Walk-In Check In (Shift+W) — Sabse Important Screen
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ WalkIn Check In
subsections.paragraph: Guest directly hotel aaye to isse check-in karo. Ye 3-part form hai: (1) Stay details upar, (2) Room/Rate details middle me, (3) Guest information neeche. Ek hi screen se pura check-in hota hai.

rows: Check-In date/time, Nights, Checkout, Room, Remarks, Pick Up/Drop
Nights change karne pe checkout auto-update hota hai
Company, Booking Source, Business Source, Bill To
Dropdowns se select karo — na ho to '+' se quick add
Room Type, Room No, Adult, Child, Plan, Rate, Tax Inc., Leader
Pehle type → phir available room → rate aajayega, tax inclusive toggle check karo
Ek guest ko multiple rooms — Add Room button
Prefix, Full Name, Mobile, Email, City, State, Country, Nationality, Zip, Address
Mobile & name required — baaki baad me bhi update ho sakta hai
WhatsApp at checkout, No Charge Post, Suppress Rate on GRC
Complimentary room ho to checkbox tick karo
Check In click → room assign, folio ban jata hai

subsections.title: 4.3 CheckIn List
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ CheckIn List
subsections.paragraph: Aaj ke (ya kisi bhi date ke) saare check-ins ki list — guest name, room, plan, rate, status. Yahan se in-house guest pe koi bhi action le sakte ho: room change, ammend stay, profile update, folio dekhna, checkout.

rows: Room Change, Ammend Stay, Profile Edit, Folio, Checkout, Room Key print

subsections.title: 4.4 Room Status (Shift+S)
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Room Status
subsections.paragraph: Poore property ka live room map — kaunsa room vacant clean, vacant dirty, occupied, out of order. Front desk check-in ke waqt yahin se available room dhundta hai. Colors ka matlab: Green=available, Red=occupied, Yellow=dirty, Gray=OOO.

subsections.title: 4.5 In-House Room Status (Shift+I)
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ In House Room Status
subsections.paragraph: Abhi hotel me rukhe saare guests ka detailed view — room wise guest, folio balance, arrival/departure. Room-wise guest lookup aur DND/vacant status ke saath.

subsections.title: 4.6 Add New Profile
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Add New Profile
subsections.paragraph: Repeat guest ya company/agent ka profile pehle se bana do — check-in ke time sirf select karna hota hai. Guest profile me name, contact, ID, preferences, GSTIN save hote hain.

rows: Name, mobile, email, address, ID proof, DOB/Anniversary
Company name, GSTIN, address, billing contact

subsections.title: 4.7 Room Change (CheckIn List se)
subsections.paragraph: Guest room change maange: CheckIn List → guest select → Room Change → naya room (vacant clean hona chahiye) → reason → save. Purana room khali ho jata hai, folio naya room pe shift ho jata hai. History 'Room Change History' report me aati hai.
steps: CheckIn List kholo
Guest row pe Room Change action click karo
Available rooms se naya room select karo
Reason daalo (optional) aur save karo

subsections.title: 4.8 Ammend Stay (Date/Rate Change)
subsections.paragraph: Guest stay extend/shorten kare ya rate change ho: CheckIn List → Ammend Stay → nayi departure date ya rate → update. Nights auto-recalculate hote hain aur folio me room charges adjust hote hain.
steps: CheckIn List → guest select karo
Ammend Stay click karo
Nayi departure date / rate daalo
Save — folio me difference post ho jayega

sections.title: 5. Transactions Module — Billing & Folio
sections.intro: Check-out ke time ya stay ke dauran billing related saare kaam. Folio = guest ka bill ledger, jisme room charges, POS charges, payments sab post hote hain.

subsections.title: 5.1 Bill Reprint
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Bill Reprint
subsections.paragraph: Purana printed bill dobara print karo — guest copy kho jaye ya duplicate chahiye. Year + Bill No. daalo → Search → details → Print. Agar bill galat tha to pehle re-settlement karke naya bill banta hai.
steps: For Year select karo
Bill No. enter karo
Search — bill details load hongi
Bill Print click karo (duplicate copy)

subsections.title: 5.2 Bill Re-Settlement
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Bill Re-Settlement
subsections.paragraph: Settled bill me galti ho jaye (galat payment mode, amount, ya guest wapas aaye) — to purana settlement reverse karke naya settlement kiya jata hai. Room/folio select karo → purana settlement load → modify → re-settle.

rows: Kis room ka bill re-settle karna hai
Kyun re-settle kiya (audit ke liye zaroori)

subsections.title: 5.3 Misc Payment / Rectification
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Misc Payment /Rect.
subsections.paragraph: Non-guest payments ya corrections — expense sheet entry: cash received/paid outside folio, petty cash, rectification entries. Cashier report me dikhta hai.

subsections.title: 5.4 Merge Folio
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Merge Folio
subsections.paragraph: Ek hi guest/family ke multiple rooms ka alag-alag folio ek me jodna — checkout pe ek hi bill. E.g. Room 101 aur 102 dono same guest ke — dono folios merge karke ek bill.
steps: Merge Folio screen kholo
Master folio select karo (jisme merge karna hai)
Merge hone wale folios select karo
Confirm — saare charges master folio me aa jayenge

subsections.title: 5.5 Reverse Merge Folio
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Reverse Merge Folio
subsections.paragraph: Galti se merge ho gaya? Reverse Merge se folios wapas alag karo — charges apne original rooms pe laut jate hain.
steps: Reverse Merge Folio kholo
Merged folio select karo
Kaunse charges reverse karne hain select karo
Confirm — folios alag ho jayenge

subsections.title: 5.6 Check-Out & Settlement Process (Complete Flow)
subsections.paragraph: Ye sabse important training flow hai — guest jaate waqt:
steps: In-House/CheckIn List se guest ka folio kholo
Saare charges verify karo — room nights, POS, laundry, minibar
Discount agar lagna ho — authorized discount % me hi
Advance/deposit adjust karo
Payment mode select karo — Cash / UPI / Card / City Ledger (company bill)
Settle click karo — GST auto-calculate hota hai
Bill print karo — guest copy + hotel copy
Room status 'Vacant Dirty' ho jata hai — HK ko inform karo

sections.title: 6. Reports Module — Daily Registers
sections.intro: Daily operations ke registers — shift handover, audit aur record keeping ke liye. Sab reports me date filter + print/export hota hai.

subsections.title: 6.1 Available Reports
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Reports
subsections.caption: Check-In Register — Reports module

rows: Date-wise saare check-ins — guest, room, rate, source
Date-wise checkouts — bill amount, payment mode
Room changes — from/to room, reason, user

sections.title: 7. MIS Reports — Management Analytics
sections.intro: Management-level analytics — revenue, company contribution, guest behaviour. Owner/GM ke liye.

subsections.title: 7.1 Available MIS Reports
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ MIS Report
subsections.caption: FOM Sale Summary — revenue breakdown

rows: Category-wise rooms — total, occupied, vacant, OOO, ADR
Revenue summary — room rent, extra charges, tax, discounts
Kaunsa company kitna revenue la raha hai
Repeat guest history — visits, spend, preferences
Business source-wise revenue — OTA vs Direct vs Corporate

subsections.title: 7.2 Tax Reports
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Tax Reports
subsections.paragraph: GST compliance report — FOM Tax Detail: date-wise room revenue ka GST breakdown (CGST/SGST), HSN code wise summary. Accountant isse GSTR filing me use karta hai.
